title: Follow the path
hints: Think recursively: getting `"a.b.c"` from `obj` is the same as getting `"b.c"` from `obj.a`. The base case is the empty path.
Split off the first segment with `path.indexOf(".")` (or `split`). Before indexing, make sure the current value is an object: `typeof v === "object" && v !== null`, otherwise return `undefined`.

if (path === "") return obj; const [head, ...rest] = path.split("."); if (typeof obj !== "object" || obj === null) return undefined; return getPath((obj as Record<string, unknown>)[head], rest.join("."));
